_about: MTG's income streams, in his order (MTG, 28 Nov 2026: Bellver Cards, ClickBaitPays, PRENET, MoveMint, Bitcoin Wealth, JetUp · TAG Markets, Aureus Alliance). The single source of truth for every stream list on mtgtribe.com and musathegiant.com. musathegiant.com reads this file automatically (its sync job, .github/sync/sync.py in mtglegacyai/musathegiant, runs every hour). When a stream is added, removed, renamed or moved, change it here in the same pull request as the mtgtribe.com pages.

streams.name: Bellver Cards
streams.tag: The crypto cards that can pay your bills.

facts: Launch news in the WhatsApp group
